questions.question: How many students from the ages of 5 to 17 are enrolled at the State Special School school in Fremont for the 2014-2015 academic year?
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld024 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld069 = 'SSS' AND T2.fld049 = 'Fremont' AND T1.fld002 BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND T2.City = 'Fremont' AND T1.`Academic Year` BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015

questions.question: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.
questions.evidence: Kindergarten to 8th grade refers to K-8; 'Offers a magnet program' means fld076 = 1; Multiple Provision Types refers to fld012 = 'Multiple Provision Types'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld049, COUNT(T2.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld076 = 1 AND T2.fld073 = 'K-8' AND T1.fld012 = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.fld049
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

questions.question: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?
questions.evidence: Full communication address should include fld047, fld049, State and zip code if any.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008, T2.fld047, T2.fld049, T2.fld051, T2.fld050 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld044 = 'Monterey' AND T1.fld025 > 800 AND T1.fld010 = 'High Schools (Public)'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

questions.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.fld046) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld075 = 'F' AND T1.fld038 > 400
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

questions.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
questions.evidence: the highest longitude refers to the school with the maximum absolute longitude value.
questions.SQL: SELECT fld073 FROM tab03 ORDER BY ABS(fld078) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
questions.evidence: Intermediate/Middle Schools refers to fld067 = 62; Unified School refers to fld065 = 54; years between 2009 and 2010 can refer to 'between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld081, T2.fld084 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld044 = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.fld049 = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.fld065 = 54 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld060) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2010' AND T2.fld067 = 62
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.DOC = 54 AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2010' AND T2.SOC = 62

questions.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
questions.evidence: Execellence Rate = fld040 / fld036; complete address has fld047, fld049, fld051, Zip code
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld047, T2.fld049, T2.fld051, T2.fld050 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 ORDER BY CAST(T1.fld040 AS REAL) / T1.fld036 ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.
questions.evidence: Usually, administrators manage the school stuff.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld046, T1.fld039 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld079 = 'Ricci' AND T2.fld080 = 'Ulrich'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'

questions.question: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
questions.evidence: K-12 refers to students in grades 1 through 12; Eligible free rate for K-12 = fld020 / fld019
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(fld020 AS REAL) / fld019 FROM tab01 ORDER BY fld019 DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 9, 2

questions.question: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
questions.evidence: Elementary School District refers to fld065 = 52; Monthly average number of schools that opened in 1980 = count(tab03 that opened in 1980) / 12
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(fld046) AS REAL) / 12 FROM tab03 WHERE fld065 = 52 AND fld044 = 'Alameda' AND STRFTIME('%Y', fld060) = '1980'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(School) AS REAL) / 12 FROM schools WHERE DOC = 52 AND County = 'Alameda' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

questions.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
questions.evidence: State Special Schools refers to fld065 = 31; Grades 1 through 12 means K-12
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld046 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld065 = 31 ORDER BY T1.fld019 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
questions.evidence: Excellence rate = fld040 / fld036; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = fld025 / fld024
questions.SQL: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.fld025 AS REAL) / T1.fld024) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld030 WHERE CAST(T2.fld040 AS REAL) / T2.fld036 > 0.3
questions.SQL_original: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

questions.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.fld036) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld030 = T2.fld001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld060) = '1980' AND T2.fld044 = 'Fresno'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

questions.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld020 * 100 / T1.fld019, T1.fld004 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld079 = 'Alusine'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T1.`District Code` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

questions.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
questions.evidence: Valid charter number means the number is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT fld063, fld039, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fld039 DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM tab03 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld030 WHERE T2.fld039 > 499 AND NOT fld063 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null
